findingsFixed.problem: Taking the latest32 provider children could evict old running or approval-waiting work.
findingsFixed.fix: Keep retained unfinished children, then other unfinished children, then recent terminal children; preserve source order. At saturation show Child list capped and explain where to inspect full activity.

findingsFixed.problem: A native approval wait did not prevent its Workspacer parent being classified finished.
findingsFixed.fix: Only explicitly terminal native children permit parent Clear; pending/unknown children remain visible. Pending statuses use warning/muted colors rather than completed success styling.

findingsFixed.problem: A click painted from an old finished snapshot could clear a child that had since resumed or requested approval.
findingsFixed.fix: Revalidate current clearability and work fingerprint at click time; no lifecycle/archive/selection side effects.

findingsFixed.problem: New finish/tool-count evidence made rows visible without retiring the prior clear mark, allowing an older replay to hide them again.
findingsFixed.fix: Remove the old mark on positive work evidence, including active/pending work; activity-only and late provider tool-count backfills do not revive old work.

findingsFixed.problem: Parent/agent strings joined with slash could collide.
findingsFixed.fix: Encode the provider parent/agent pair as a JSON tuple in the device-local key; preserve the separate session-id namespace.

findingsFixed.problem: Explicitly older run or same-run finish timestamps could regress provider state.
findingsFixed.fix: Preserve the newer retained state when timestamps prove staleness; fresh active status without ordering proof is not latched terminal.

findingsFixed.problem: Pending fleet read preserved child arrays but rolled completed tool count9 back to2.
findingsFixed.fix: Overlay parsed numeric counter evidence through all supported aliases, alongside bounded subagent/workflow projections. Extended protocol regression failed before this correction and passes after it.
